recall.question: Name the three gaps in the scaling-law paper and their checks.
recall.answer: (1) No residuals: fit quality unknown, plot them. (2) No E discussion: exponent confounded, fit E jointly. (3) 1 order of magnitude: range too narrow, widen or bound claims.
